description: Warnings leave the configuration valid, so the exit code stays 0. They come sorted by key, and say which ones a later phase will end: read.classes[0] names a tag no disk carries, while read.classes is a feature of phase 2a and defaults.mode asks for a mode of phase 1b. Only what the file sets gets one: every other key stays at its default, silently.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[defaults]
mode = "scheduled"
[read]
classes = ["sata", "usb"]
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
tags = ["usb"]
